summary_en: NOF Corporation authorized the acquisition of up to 2.1 million shares (0.94% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 5 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 6 and December 31, 2026, as part of capital efficiency improvements and stable shareholder returns under its mid-term plan targeting a 70% or higher total payout ratio.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 5, 2026, NOF Corporation's Board of Directors approved the acquisition of treasury stock under Article 165(3) of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 2.1 million shares of its common stock, representing 0.94% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum total of 5 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 6 through December 31, 2026.

The company recognizes shareholder returns as a key management priority. In its mid-term management plan "NOF VISION 2030 Stage III" (fiscal years 2026-2028) announced in May 2026, NOF set stable and continuous profit returns as a basic policy, with a target total payout ratio of 70% or higher. The current buyback initiative is intended to enhance capital efficiency while maintaining this shareholder return commitment. As of October 31, 2026, the company held 223,011,878 shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock) and owned 3,512,250 treasury shares, plus an additional 52,100 shares held by the stock grant trust (BBT-RS) not included in the treasury stock count.
